{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id entries and keep the highest sample_seq for each
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify the number of unique patients
print(f'Unique patients after deduplication: {trial_df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check the value counts for 'arm' and 'severity' to understand the distribution
print('\nArm distribution:')
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())
print('\nSeverity distribution:')
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check for any sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline:')
print(trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].count())"}
